prompt: A stylized cluster of woodland mushrooms growing from a mossy fallen log. Five warm russet caps with pale undersides, varied stem heights, a few small young mushrooms, layered bark and visible growth rings on the cut log ends. Cohesive, solid low-poly geometry, a readable silhouette, and a compact game-ready prop.

barkColor.label: Bark Color
barkColor.description: Base bark tone; lighter overlapping scales follow this color.

woodColor.label: Cut Wood Color
woodColor.description: Colors the cut ends and branch tip, with coordinated darker growth rings.

mossColor.label: Moss Color
mossColor.description: Base moss tone multiplied by seeded green patch variations.

logLength.label: Log Length
logLength.description: Also adjusts mushroom spacing and moss distribution along the log.

logRadius.label: Log Radius
logRadius.description: Scales bark, cut ends, moss thickness, and the attached branch.

matureCount.label: Mature Mushroom Count
matureCount.description: The first five use the original arrangement; additional mushrooms use seeded placement.

youngCount.label: Young Mushroom Count
youngCount.description: Number of smaller, rounded button mushrooms.

stemHeight.label: Stem Height Multiplier
stemHeight.description: Scales all stem heights and their natural lean while retaining height variation.

capSize.label: Cap Size Multiplier
capSize.description: Scales cap width and dome height, with matching stem thickness.

mossCount.label: Moss Patch Count
mossCount.description: Controls moss coverage; zero removes the moss.
